WITH 
INPUT_SCOPE AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeMode}}' IN ('ME', 'TEAM', 'SELLER', 'GLOBAL') THEN '{{scopeMode}}' ELSE 'ME' END AS SCOPE_MODE,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeUserId}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeUserId}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_USER_ID,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodRca}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeCodRca}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_COD_RCA,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodSupervisor}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeCodSupervisor}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodFilial}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeCodFilial}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeCodFilial}}') END AS SCOPE_CODFILIAL,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodepto}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeCodepto}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeCodepto}}') END AS SCOPE_CODEPTO,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeIdSecao}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeIdSecao}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeIdSecao}}') END AS SCOPE_ID_SECAO
),
TARGET_USERS AS (
  SELECT :VAR_USER AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'ME'

  UNION

  SELECT F.ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN FUNCIONARIOS F ON F.ID_SUBSTITUTO = :VAR_USER
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'ME'

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN COORDENADORES C ON C.USER_ID = :VAR_USER AND COALESCE(C.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  JOIN COORDENADORES_BU CB ON CB.COD_SUPERVISOR = C.COD_SUPERVISOR
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV
    ON TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
   AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'TEAM'
    AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM COORDENADORES C_COORD_ALVO
      WHERE C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
        AND COALESCE(C_COORD_ALVO.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID <> :VAR_USER
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN INT_USER U ON U.ID = :VAR_USER
  LEFT JOIN USUARIO_CARGO UC ON UC.USER_ID = U.ID
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'SELLER'
    AND (
      UPPER(COALESCE(UC.CARGO, '')) IN ('ADMIN', 'DIRETORIA')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(U.DESCR, '')) = 'ti@benenutri.com'
    )
    AND (BV.VENDEDOR_ID = I.SCOPE_USER_ID OR VR.COD_RCA = I.SCOPE_COD_RCA)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM COORDENADORES_BU CB_GLOBAL
        WHERE CB_GLOBAL.COD_SUPERVISOR = I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR
          AND TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
          AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
      )
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN COORDENADORES C ON C.USER_ID = :VAR_USER AND COALESCE(C.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  JOIN COORDENADORES_BU CB ON CB.COD_SUPERVISOR = C.COD_SUPERVISOR
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV
    ON TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
   AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'SELLER'
    AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM COORDENADORES C_COORD_ALVO
      WHERE C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
        AND COALESCE(C_COORD_ALVO.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID <> :VAR_USER
    )
    AND (BV.VENDEDOR_ID = I.SCOPE_USER_ID OR VR.COD_RCA = I.SCOPE_COD_RCA)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN INT_USER U ON U.ID = :VAR_USER
  LEFT JOIN USUARIO_CARGO UC ON UC.USER_ID = U.ID
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'GLOBAL'
    AND (
      UPPER(COALESCE(UC.CARGO, '')) IN ('ADMIN', 'DIRETORIA')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(U.DESCR, '')) = 'ti@benenutri.com'
    )
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM COORDENADORES_BU CB_GLOBAL
        WHERE CB_GLOBAL.COD_SUPERVISOR = I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR
          AND TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
          AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
      )
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )
),
CARTEIRA_ESCOPO AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    EC.ID_CLIENTE,
    EC.ID_VENDEDOR,
    VR.COD_RCA,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)), ''), 'PADRAO') AS ID_BU,
    TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) AS CODFILIAL,
    TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) AS CODEPTO,
    BV.ID_SECAO
  FROM EQUIPE_CLIENTE EC
  JOIN TARGET_USERS TU ON TU.USER_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR
  LEFT JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON BV.VENDEDOR_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  LEFT JOIN INPUT_SCOPE I ON 1 = 1
  WHERE /*TITULAR_DEPTO*/ NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM CLIENTE_TITULAR_DEPTO T_TIT
      WHERE T_TIT.ID_CLIENTE = EC.ID_CLIENTE
        AND T_TIT.CODFILIAL = TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), ''))
        AND T_TIT.CODEPTO = TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR))
        AND T_TIT.ID_SECAO = BV.ID_SECAO
        AND COALESCE(T_TIT.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND T_TIT.VENDEDOR_ID NOT IN (SELECT TU_TIT.USER_ID FROM TARGET_USERS TU_TIT)
        AND T_TIT.VENDEDOR_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT UB_EXC.USER_ID FROM USUARIO_BLOQUEIO UB_EXC WHERE UB_EXC.BLOQUEADO = 1
    UNION
    SELECT UI_EXC.ID FROM INT_USER UI_EXC WHERE LOWER(TRIM(UI_EXC.DESCR)) IN ('comunicacao@benenutri.com')
  )
    )
    AND ('{{idBu}}' = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)), ''), 'PADRAO') = '{{idBu}}')
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )
)
SELECT
  C.ID,
  C.RAZAO_SOCIAL,
  C.NOME_FANTASIA,
  C.CNPJ,
  C.CIDADE,
  C.UF,
  C.SEGMENTO,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo') AS RAMO_CLIENTE,
  C.STATUS,
  MIN(CE.ID_BU) AS ID_BU,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CE.ID_VENDEDOR = :VAR_USER THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IS_COBERTURA,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CE.ID_VENDEDOR = :VAR_USER THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '' ELSE 'COBERTURA' END AS TAG_COBERTURA,
  COALESCE(MAX(IA.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA), 999) AS DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA,
  COALESCE(VIA.DIAS_SEM_VISITA, 999) AS DIAS_SEM_VISITA,
  MIN(CE.ID_VENDEDOR) AS ID_VENDEDOR
FROM CLIENTES C
JOIN CARTEIRA_ESCOPO CE ON CE.ID_CLIENTE = C.ID
LEFT JOIN IMP_CLIENTES_TOTVS IT ON IT.CODCLI = COALESCE(C.WINTHOR_CODCLI, C.ID)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    VT.CODCLI,
    TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(VT.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) AS CODFILIAL,
    TRIM(CAST(VT.CODEPTO AS CHAR)) AS CODEPTO,
    TRIM(CAST(VT.CODSEC AS CHAR)) AS CODSEC,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, MAX(SUBSTRING(VT.DTSAIDA, 1, 10))) AS DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA
  FROM IMP_VENDAS_DASHBOARD_TOTVS_RCA VT
  GROUP BY VT.CODCLI, TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(VT.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')), TRIM(CAST(VT.CODEPTO AS CHAR)), TRIM(CAST(VT.CODSEC AS CHAR))
) IA ON TRIM(CAST(IA.CODCLI AS CHAR)) = TRIM(CAST(COALESCE(C.WINTHOR_CODCLI, C.ID) AS CHAR))
  AND IA.CODFILIAL = CE.CODFILIAL
  AND IA.CODEPTO = CE.CODEPTO
  AND (
    CE.ID_SECAO IS NULL
    OR TRIM(CAST(CE.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = IA.CODSEC
    OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(CE.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = IA.CODSEC
  )
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    V.CLIENTE_ID,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN V.STATUS = 'CONCLUIDA' THEN SUBSTRING(V.DATA_AGENDADA, 1, 10) END)) AS DIAS_SEM_VISITA
  FROM VISITAS V
  GROUP BY V.CLIENTE_ID
) VIA ON VIA.CLIENTE_ID = C.ID
WHERE 1 = 1

    AND (
      '{{busca}}' = ''
      OR UPPER(C.NOME_FANTASIA) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(C.RAZAO_SOCIAL) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(C.CNPJ) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(CAST(C.ID AS CHAR)) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
    )
    AND ('{{segmento}}' = '' OR C.SEGMENTO = '{{segmento}}')
    AND ('{{ramoCliente}}' = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo') = '{{ramoCliente}}')
    AND ('{{status}}' = '' OR C.STATUS = '{{status}}')
    AND ('{{cidade}}' = '' OR C.CIDADE LIKE '%{{cidade}}%')
    AND ('{{uf}}' = '' OR C.UF = '{{uf}}')
GROUP BY C.ID, C.RAZAO_SOCIAL, C.NOME_FANTASIA, C.CNPJ, C.CIDADE, C.UF, C.SEGMENTO, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo'), C.STATUS, VIA.DIAS_SEM_VISITA
ORDER BY C.NOME_FANTASIA
LIMIT {{limit}} OFFSET {{offset}}

WITH 
INPUT_SCOPE AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeMode}}' IN ('ME', 'TEAM', 'SELLER', 'GLOBAL') THEN '{{scopeMode}}' ELSE 'ME' END AS SCOPE_MODE,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeUserId}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeUserId}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_USER_ID,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodRca}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeCodRca}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_COD_RCA,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodSupervisor}}' REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST('{{scopeCodSupervisor}}' AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodFilial}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeCodFilial}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeCodFilial}}') END AS SCOPE_CODFILIAL,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeCodepto}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeCodepto}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeCodepto}}') END AS SCOPE_CODEPTO,
    CASE WHEN '{{scopeIdSecao}}' = '' OR LOCATE('{', '{{scopeIdSecao}}') > 0 THEN NULL ELSE TRIM('{{scopeIdSecao}}') END AS SCOPE_ID_SECAO
),
TARGET_USERS AS (
  SELECT :VAR_USER AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'ME'

  UNION

  SELECT F.ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN FUNCIONARIOS F ON F.ID_SUBSTITUTO = :VAR_USER
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'ME'

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN COORDENADORES C ON C.USER_ID = :VAR_USER AND COALESCE(C.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  JOIN COORDENADORES_BU CB ON CB.COD_SUPERVISOR = C.COD_SUPERVISOR
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV
    ON TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
   AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'TEAM'
    AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM COORDENADORES C_COORD_ALVO
      WHERE C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
        AND COALESCE(C_COORD_ALVO.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID <> :VAR_USER
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN INT_USER U ON U.ID = :VAR_USER
  LEFT JOIN USUARIO_CARGO UC ON UC.USER_ID = U.ID
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'SELLER'
    AND (
      UPPER(COALESCE(UC.CARGO, '')) IN ('ADMIN', 'DIRETORIA')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(U.DESCR, '')) = 'ti@benenutri.com'
    )
    AND (BV.VENDEDOR_ID = I.SCOPE_USER_ID OR VR.COD_RCA = I.SCOPE_COD_RCA)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM COORDENADORES_BU CB_GLOBAL
        WHERE CB_GLOBAL.COD_SUPERVISOR = I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR
          AND TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
          AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
      )
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN COORDENADORES C ON C.USER_ID = :VAR_USER AND COALESCE(C.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  JOIN COORDENADORES_BU CB ON CB.COD_SUPERVISOR = C.COD_SUPERVISOR
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV
    ON TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
   AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'SELLER'
    AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM COORDENADORES C_COORD_ALVO
      WHERE C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID = BV.VENDEDOR_ID
        AND COALESCE(C_COORD_ALVO.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND C_COORD_ALVO.USER_ID <> :VAR_USER
    )
    AND (BV.VENDEDOR_ID = I.SCOPE_USER_ID OR VR.COD_RCA = I.SCOPE_COD_RCA)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT BV.VENDEDOR_ID AS USER_ID
  FROM INPUT_SCOPE I
  JOIN INT_USER U ON U.ID = :VAR_USER
  LEFT JOIN USUARIO_CARGO UC ON UC.USER_ID = U.ID
  JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  WHERE I.SCOPE_MODE = 'GLOBAL'
    AND (
      UPPER(COALESCE(UC.CARGO, '')) IN ('ADMIN', 'DIRETORIA')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(U.DESCR, '')) = 'ti@benenutri.com'
    )
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM COORDENADORES_BU CB_GLOBAL
        WHERE CB_GLOBAL.COD_SUPERVISOR = I.SCOPE_COD_SUPERVISOR
          AND TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODFILIAL AS CHAR)
          AND TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = CAST(CB_GLOBAL.CODEPTO AS CHAR)
      )
    )
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )
),
CARTEIRA_ESCOPO AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    EC.ID_CLIENTE,
    EC.ID_VENDEDOR,
    VR.COD_RCA,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)), ''), 'PADRAO') AS ID_BU,
    TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) AS CODFILIAL,
    TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) AS CODEPTO,
    BV.ID_SECAO
  FROM EQUIPE_CLIENTE EC
  JOIN TARGET_USERS TU ON TU.USER_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR
  LEFT JOIN VENDEDOR_RCA VR ON VR.USER_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR
  LEFT JOIN BU_VENDEDOR BV ON BV.VENDEDOR_ID = EC.ID_VENDEDOR AND COALESCE(BV.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
  LEFT JOIN INPUT_SCOPE I ON 1 = 1
  WHERE /*TITULAR_DEPTO*/ NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM CLIENTE_TITULAR_DEPTO T_TIT
      WHERE T_TIT.ID_CLIENTE = EC.ID_CLIENTE
        AND T_TIT.CODFILIAL = TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), ''))
        AND T_TIT.CODEPTO = TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR))
        AND T_TIT.ID_SECAO = BV.ID_SECAO
        AND COALESCE(T_TIT.ATIVO, TRUE) = TRUE
        AND T_TIT.VENDEDOR_ID NOT IN (SELECT TU_TIT.USER_ID FROM TARGET_USERS TU_TIT)
        AND T_TIT.VENDEDOR_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT UB_EXC.USER_ID FROM USUARIO_BLOQUEIO UB_EXC WHERE UB_EXC.BLOQUEADO = 1
    UNION
    SELECT UI_EXC.ID FROM INT_USER UI_EXC WHERE LOWER(TRIM(UI_EXC.DESCR)) IN ('comunicacao@benenutri.com')
  )
    )
    AND ('{{idBu}}' = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)), ''), 'PADRAO') = '{{idBu}}')
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL IS NULL OR TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(BV.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = I.SCOPE_CODFILIAL)
    AND (I.SCOPE_CODEPTO IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BV.BU_CODIGO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_CODEPTO)
    AND (
      I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO IS NULL
      OR TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
      OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(BV.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = I.SCOPE_ID_SECAO
    )
),
SALES AS (
  SELECT
    CE.ID_CLIENTE,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(VT.DTSAIDA, 1, 10) >= SUBSTRING(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY), 1, 10) THEN COALESCE(VT.TOTAL, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS COMPRAS_90D,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, MAX(SUBSTRING(VT.DTSAIDA, 1, 10))) AS DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA
  FROM CARTEIRA_ESCOPO CE
  JOIN CLIENTES C_SALES ON C_SALES.ID = CE.ID_CLIENTE
  LEFT JOIN IMP_VENDAS_DASHBOARD_TOTVS_RCA VT
    ON TRIM(CAST(VT.CODCLI AS CHAR)) = TRIM(CAST(COALESCE(C_SALES.WINTHOR_CODCLI, C_SALES.ID) AS CHAR))
   AND TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(VT.CODFILIAL AS CHAR), '')) = CE.CODFILIAL
   AND TRIM(CAST(VT.CODEPTO AS CHAR)) = CE.CODEPTO
   AND (
     CE.ID_SECAO IS NULL
     OR TRIM(CAST(CE.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)) = TRIM(CAST(VT.CODSEC AS CHAR))
     OR LPAD(TRIM(CAST(CE.ID_SECAO AS CHAR)), 2, '0') = TRIM(CAST(VT.CODSEC AS CHAR))
   )
  GROUP BY CE.ID_CLIENTE
),
VISITAS_AGG AS (
  SELECT
    V.CLIENTE_ID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN V.STATUS = 'CONCLUIDA' AND SUBSTRING(V.DATA_AGENDADA, 1, 10) >= SUBSTRING(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 60 DAY), 1, 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VISITAS_60D,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN V.STATUS = 'CONCLUIDA' THEN SUBSTRING(V.DATA_AGENDADA, 1, 10) END)) AS DIAS_SEM_VISITA
  FROM VISITAS V
  GROUP BY V.CLIENTE_ID
),
BASE AS (
  SELECT
    C.ID,
    C.RAZAO_SOCIAL,
    C.NOME_FANTASIA,
    C.CNPJ,
    C.CIDADE,
    C.UF,
    C.SEGMENTO,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo') AS RAMO_CLIENTE,
    C.STATUS,
    MIN(CE.ID_BU) AS ID_BU,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CE.ID_VENDEDOR = :VAR_USER THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IS_COBERTURA,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CE.ID_VENDEDOR = :VAR_USER THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '' ELSE 'COBERTURA' END AS TAG_COBERTURA,
    COALESCE(S.COMPRAS_90D, 0) AS COMPRAS_90D,
    COALESCE(VA.VISITAS_60D, 0) AS VISITAS_60D,
    COALESCE(S.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA, 999) AS DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA,
    COALESCE(VA.DIAS_SEM_VISITA, 999) AS DIAS_SEM_VISITA,
    MIN(CE.ID_VENDEDOR) AS ID_VENDEDOR
  FROM CLIENTES C
  JOIN CARTEIRA_ESCOPO CE ON CE.ID_CLIENTE = C.ID
  LEFT JOIN IMP_CLIENTES_TOTVS IT ON IT.CODCLI = COALESCE(C.WINTHOR_CODCLI, C.ID)
  LEFT JOIN SALES S ON S.ID_CLIENTE = C.ID
  LEFT JOIN VISITAS_AGG VA ON VA.CLIENTE_ID = C.ID
  WHERE 1 = 1

    AND (
      '{{busca}}' = ''
      OR UPPER(C.NOME_FANTASIA) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(C.RAZAO_SOCIAL) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(C.CNPJ) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
      OR UPPER(CAST(C.ID AS CHAR)) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER('{{busca}}'), '%')
    )
    AND ('{{segmento}}' = '' OR C.SEGMENTO = '{{segmento}}')
    AND ('{{ramoCliente}}' = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo') = '{{ramoCliente}}')
    AND ('{{status}}' = '' OR C.STATUS = '{{status}}')
    AND ('{{cidade}}' = '' OR C.CIDADE LIKE '%{{cidade}}%')
    AND ('{{uf}}' = '' OR C.UF = '{{uf}}')
  GROUP BY C.ID, C.RAZAO_SOCIAL, C.NOME_FANTASIA, C.CNPJ, C.CIDADE, C.UF, C.SEGMENTO, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IT.RAMO), ''), 'Sem ramo'), C.STATUS, S.COMPRAS_90D, S.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA, VA.VISITAS_60D, VA.DIAS_SEM_VISITA
)
SELECT
  B.*,
  ROUND(
    (LEAST(100, (B.COMPRAS_90D / 30000) * 100) * 0.45)
    + (LEAST(100, B.VISITAS_60D * 20) * 0.25)
    + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 15 THEN 85 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 30 THEN 65 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 45 THEN 40 ELSE 15 END) * 0.20)
    + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 15 THEN 80 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 30 THEN 55 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 45 THEN 30 ELSE 10 END) * 0.10),
    1
  ) AS SCORE_RANKING,
  CASE
    WHEN ROUND((LEAST(100, (B.COMPRAS_90D / 30000) * 100) * 0.45) + (LEAST(100, B.VISITAS_60D * 20) * 0.25) + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 15 THEN 85 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 30 THEN 65 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 45 THEN 40 ELSE 15 END) * 0.20) + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 15 THEN 80 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 30 THEN 55 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 45 THEN 30 ELSE 10 END) * 0.10), 1) >= 80 THEN 'A'
    WHEN ROUND((LEAST(100, (B.COMPRAS_90D / 30000) * 100) * 0.45) + (LEAST(100, B.VISITAS_60D * 20) * 0.25) + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 15 THEN 85 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 30 THEN 65 WHEN B.DIAS_ULTIMA_COMPRA <= 45 THEN 40 ELSE 15 END) * 0.20) + ((CASE WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 7 THEN 100 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 15 THEN 80 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 30 THEN 55 WHEN B.DIAS_SEM_VISITA <= 45 THEN 30 ELSE 10 END) * 0.10), 1) >= 55 THEN 'B'
    ELSE 'C'
  END AS RANKING
FROM BASE B
ORDER BY B.NOME_FANTASIA
LIMIT {{limit}} OFFSET {{offset}}
